theorems.name: Submission.intcpt_allard_bad_set_bound
theorems.statement: MonotonicityFormula → ∀ (N n : ℕ) (Λ : ℝ), 1 ≤ Λ → ∃ c₀ : ℝ, 0 ≤ c₀ ∧ ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ε ≤ 1 → ∀ (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (W : Varifold N n U) (P : Grassmannian N n), ball (0 : Euclidean N) 3 ⊆ U → W.HasLocallyBoundedFirstVariation → W.weight (ball (0 : Euclidean N) 3) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal Λ → variationMeasure W (ball (0 : Euclidean N) 3) < ENNReal.ofReal (ε ^ 2) → (∫⁻ z in ball (0 : Euclidean N) 3 ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n)), ENNReal.ofReal ‖LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (Grassmannian.projectionLinearMap z.2 - Grassmannian.projectionLinearMap P)‖ ∂W.measure) < ENNReal.ofReal (ε ^ 2) → W.weight {y | y ∈ closedBall (0 : Euclidean N) 2 ∧ y ∈ W.weight.support ∧ ¬ ((∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ < 1 → variationMeasure W (closedBall y ρ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ε * W.weight (closedBall y ρ)) ∧ (∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ < 1 → (∫⁻ z in closedBall y ρ ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n)), ENNReal.ofReal ‖LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (Grassmannian.projectionLinearMap z.2 - Grassmannian.projectionLinearMap P)‖ ∂W.measure) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (ε * ρ ^ n)))} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (c₀ * ε)
